title: Dumpall
body:
List all ids registered.

Command `/dumpall` to run, dump to `<installation folder>/dumpall` directory. Output files are tsv format, they have only single column; as just resource locations/identifiers lists.

Each files located as registry ids.  
For example items is dumped in `<installation folder>/dumpall/minecraft/item.tsv`  
another example biome tag is dumped in `<installation folder>/dumpall/minecraft/tags/worldgen/biome.tsv`

I guess this mod could help to make datapacks or modpacks. The output files of this mod are simple tsv, you can process these outputs into what useable you working on.
